name: services/examrep/course_edition2
description:
Get exam reports related to given course edition.

Access to grades have only coordinators and lecturers of the course edition
brief_description: Get exams and grades related to given course edition

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of exam method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • course_exams - Array of exam reports related to course or null if doesn't exist..

    This field references objects returned by exam method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

  • course_units_exams - Dictionary mapping course unit ID to arrays of related exam reports..

    This field references objects returned by exam method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

result_fields.name: course_exams
result_fields.description: Array of exam reports related to course or null if doesn't exist.

result_fields.name: course_units_exams
result_fields.description: Dictionary mapping course unit ID to arrays of related exam reports.
